title: Sec 2 G3 English
description: Secondary 2 G3 English (MOE English Language Syllabus 2020, Secondary G2/G3): editing for grammatical errors, visual text, narrative and non-narrative comprehension (vocabulary in context, language for effect) and summary writing, practised in the SEC G3 format.
subject: english
syllabus: MOE English Language Syllabus 2020, Secondary G2 and G3 (lower secondary); SEC G3 English Language K300 format

archetypes.pattern: Editing text of up to 250 words: find the grammatical error in a line and write the correction (tense, agreement, prepositions, relatives, noun number, verb forms)
Sentence drill: which underlined part contains the grammatical error
Main purpose of an advertisement, poster or web page
Intended audience and the detail that shows it
How a picture, layout or font supports the message
Persuasive language for effect: questions, imperatives, testimonials, statistics, inclusive 'you' and 'we'
Why a character acts; what a detail suggests
Vocabulary in context: give or find a word or phrase with a given meaning
Language for effect: simile, metaphor, personification, word choice, sentence length; quote, meaning, effect
A character's feelings shown through actions, with explanation
What the ending or a key line suggests about the story's message, with evidence
What a writer's word choice or closing line suggests or does to the reader
Find a word in a given paragraph with a given meaning
The writer's view, attitude or purpose across the whole text
Explain an idea or claim in the writer's argument
Separate main points from examples and details
Rewrite a point in own words and structures within a word limit
Continuous-prose summary of about 80 words after given opening words
